core_style.default_register: casual - often informal and playful, as seen in karaoke scenes
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs - frequently strings together multiple clauses for emphasis
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick to jump between thoughts and ideas
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more serious tone when discussing personal failures or legal matters, contrasting with his usual light-heartedness

humor.style: absurdist - often makes exaggerated statements for comedic effect
humor.frequency: constant - humor is a staple in his interactions, especially in tense situations
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up expectations with a serious tone, then delivers a punchline that flips the context

structural_patterns: uses rhetorical questions to engage listeners
frequently employs hyperbole for comedic effect
self-interrupts to pivot to a different thought or joke
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations or people in humorous ways, revealing his desire to control narratives and perceptions
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and vulnerable, often shorter and more emotional when discussing personal loss or guilt

worldview.belief in self-advancement: demonstrates a belief that success often requires bending the rules, as seen in his encouragement to Kim to take what she deserves
worldview.value of personal connection: shows that relationships matter to him, especially when he expresses concern for Kim and his brother Chuck

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to deflect deeper emotions, maintaining a light-hearted facade
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes fragmented and hurried, revealing his anxiety through rapid-fire dialogue
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, poignant statements, lacking his usual bravado
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through assertive speech, often using humor to dominate conversations

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to banter or stall, but if that fails, he becomes more aggressive or defensive
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with humor and sarcasm, often challenging their authority directly
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and protective, focusing on their safety and well-being
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects the conversation or attempts to justify his actions rather than admitting fault

register_shift_triggers: discussions about personal failure or guilt cause him to drop his humorous facade and become serious
confrontations with authority figures lead to a more defensive and aggressive tone
moments of vulnerability, especially regarding family, trigger a shift to a more emotional register
social_positioning: positions himself as a charismatic underdog, often at odds with authority, which creates tension in his relationships and a desire for acceptance
